title: Japanese Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired dish using noodles and a variety of ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: outward
ingredients.notes: outward (such as bok choy or Chinese broccoli)

ingredients.name: japanese
ingredients.notes: Japanese seasonings (such as soy sauce or sesame oil)

instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oily in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the papelon and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until slightly charred.
Add the outward and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the outward and papelon.
Season with Japanese seasonings and serve hot.
